videos.title: Documentary 360
videos.description: Featuring documentaries that shed light on politics, the economy, social trends, science and the environment in Japan and beyond.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

videos.title: Encounters With Artists
videos.description: Yayoi Kusama creates original costumes she regards as the source of her creativity, as cameras follow the acclaimed artist at work and explore the ideas behind her art.

videos.title: The Cats Eye Museum
videos.description: World-famous artist Yayoi Kusama is known for polka dots. A giant pumpkin, mysterious ladder and a chandelier expand into infinity. Explore her world with two unusual cats.

videos.title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan
videos.description: From natural landscapes to historic architecture, Japan's World Heritage sites offer a wide range of history and the beauty of nature. This time, a look at Gusuku sites and related properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

videos.title: Grand Sumo Live
videos.description: NHK WORLD-JAPAN will broadcast Grand Sumo November Tournament Opening Day action live from the Fukuoka Kokusai Centre, as all the top wrestlers have their first bouts in the last tourney of the year.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

videos.title: Design X Stories
videos.description: Explore the beauty and potential of Japanese Modern Design, a fusion of rational Western Modernism and traditional Japanese materials and skills.

videos.title: Story Land in Classical Japanese
videos.description: An old childless couple live with their beloved dog. One day, while digging in the garden, the dog finds a box of gold coins. A neighbour sees this and thinks the dog must have the ability to find treasure.

videos.title: Texico
videos.description: Fascinating experiments that help people visualise sequences and predict future outcomes. Conveys the pleasure found in improving sequence patterns and how programming principles can be discovered in many aspects of daily life.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

videos.title: CYCLE AROUND TAIWAN
videos.description: Featuring indigenous cultures in the south and on the east coast, we meet a Rukai man preserving the forest and Bunun people with a stunning choral tradition.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: Hourly news updates featuring current affairs, business news, financial updates and global weather forecasts.

videos.title: BOSAI: Science That Can Save Your Life
videos.description: Tokyo Skytree, one of Japan's most famous tourist attractions, is equipped with a variety of countermeasures against disasters. We'll go behind the scenes to explore the tower's advanced technologies.

videos.title: Design Museum Japan
videos.description: The crew visit Shimane Prefecture to explore red Sekishu roof tiles, which are designed for cold and snowy weather.

videos.title: Kabuki Kool
videos.description: Sasaki Moritsuna has captured Koshiro, the young son of his brother Takatsuna, but worries that love for his son will tempt Takatsuna to go against the warrior code and betray his lord.
